offence: Breach of Article 48.1 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed in-car video evidence. Car 27 moved after the four seconds signal was illuminated and before the start signal was given. As there was only slight movement and no sporting advantage appeared to be gained, the least severe penalty available is imposed.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 27 False Start
to: The Team Manager, Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber
